title: Supported endpoint transport of the compact-support exchange
statement:
Supported endpoint transport of the compact-support exchange. With the exact objects and canonical maps of [def-pur-section-compact-source-maps], for every finite commutative A and arbitrary schemes and base change, the following equation holds. No Noetherian, finite-type or nonempty hypothesis is required.

theorem sourceComparison_exchange
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {B X B' X' : Scheme.{u}} {h : X ⟶ B} {h' : X' ⟶ B'}
    {v : X' ⟶ X} {g : B' ⟶ B} (sq : IsPullback v h' h g)
    (c : Compactification h) (s : B ⟶ X) (s' : B' ⟶ X')
    [IsClosedImmersion s] [IsClosedImmersion s']
    (sqS : ChosenCartesianSquare g s' s v) :
    (ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
        (sourceComparison A c s) ≫ proExchange A sq c (proSupported A s) ≫
      (ProEtale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlus
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (c.ofIsPullback sq)).map (proBeta A sqS) =
    (ProEtale.fixedComparisonPullbackPlus A g).inv.app
        ((Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlus
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c).obj (etaleSupported A s)) ≫
      (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) B').mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
        ((Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlusBaseChangeMap A sq c).app
            (etaleSupported A s) ≫
          (Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlus
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (c.ofIsPullback sq)).map (etaleBeta A sqS)) ≫
      sourceComparison A (c.ofIsPullback sq) s'

proof.text: Apply the canonical compact-support site-exchange square to the etale supported constant of the closed section. Naturality of proExchange moves the supported comparison through the exchange.

The closed supported-constant comparison square identifies the two endpoint maps. This uses only the etale open/closed exact sequence: its constant restriction is epi. Precompose by its image under the exact comparison and pullback. Exchange normalization and gamma normalization reduce the equality to the constant-unit comparison square. Thus the argument works for arbitrary finite A, not only the coefficient of PurityFiniteSetting.

Naturality of compactSupportSiteComparisonPlus at etaleBeta, functoriality, and cancellation of the pullback comparison combine the previous squares into the displayed equation. There is no etale section-source equation or scalar-source endpoint in this statement.
